info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Broker Agreement Management API
info.description: The Product Broker Agreement Management API facilitates the creation and management of broker agreements within the banking ecosystem. This API enables financial institutions and external agencies to initiate and record agreements related to product offerings efficiently. Typical consumers include banking institutions and third-party brokers looking to formalize their partnerships. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their collaboration processes, ensuring compliance and transparency in agreement management.

post.summary: Create a new Product Broker Agreement for an external agency.
post.description: This operation allows users to create a new Product Broker Agreement associated with a specified external agency. Ensure that all required fields are filled in the request body to successfully create the agreement.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for creating or updating the product broker agreement for an external agency. It contains the necessary information that defines the terms and conditions of the agreement, aimed at facilitating cooperation between the external agency and the broker.
